name: adapt_moved_package_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the package the agent's first solution imports is MOVED to a new path between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old package deleted, new one created); the agent must update its import, not keep pointing at the old location
prompts: pricing/rules.go (package pricing) exports a const Discount. Create checkout.go (package checkout) with a function ApplyDiscount(price float64) float64 that returns price * (1 - pricing.Discount), importing "movedpkgcase/pricing".

pricing/rules.go has moved to config/rules.go (package config, same Discount value, import path "movedpkgcase/config"). Update checkout.go's import to use the new location - do not keep importing the old pricing package.

disruptions.description: pricing package moved to config package
